full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Mahmud Hossain J.: This Rule was issued on an application for revision made by the plaintiff-appellant under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure (the Code) against order No.2 dated 14.7.1994 rejecting the application filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act and Order No. 4 dated 20.7.1994 rejecting the application filed under section 151 of the Code passed by the learned District Judge, Bagerhat in Title Appeal No. 144 of 1994. 

 3. The learned Assistant Judge dismissed the suit by Judgment and decree dated 2.1.1994. The plaintiff. thereafter, filed Title Appeal No.144 of 1994 before the learned District Judge, Bagerhat along with an application for condonation of delay of 11 days in filing the appeal. The learned District Judge rejected the application for condonation of delay by the impugned order dated 14.7.1994 and thereby dismissed the appeal as well. The plaintiff appellant, thereafter, filed an application on 16.7.1994 under section 151 of the Code supported by an affidavit praying for admission of the appeal for hearing after setting aside the order of dismissal of the appeal dated 14.7.1994. The learned District Judge rejected that application filed under section 151 of the Code by another impugned order No.4 dated 20.7.1994.
